explanation: The first human created by God, the ancestor of all humanity.
Adam's wife and the first woman, mother of Cain, Abel, and Seth.
The third son of Adam and Eve, regarded as the ancestor of the righteous line of people.
A righteous man chosen by God to build the ark and survive the flood with his family and the animals.
Noah's three sons, from whom all nations on earth descended after the flood.
The ancestor of the Israelites, who made a covenant with God that his descendants would become a great nation.
Abraham's son by Sarah, father of Jacob and Esau, blessed by God and part of the covenant.
Isaac's son, known as Israel, father of the twelve tribes of Israel.
Isaac's son and Jacob's twin brother, ancestor of the Edomites.
One of Jacob's twelve sons, sold into slavery by his brothers, but later became a powerful leader in Egypt.
A sacred agreement between God and people, often connected with promises and blessings.
